source: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE 1 m DTM (DOI 10.5066/P9REJ9JN), box-averaged to 2 m by tools/data/bake_terrain.py and cut by tools/data/bake_patch.py
use: Fetch terrain_patch_2m.bin as an ArrayBuffer and read it as Uint16Array (little-endian). heightM = minM + value * scaleM. Row 0 is the tile's north edge, column 0 its west edge.
frame: Same frame as jezero_pack.json elevation: metres from the map's north-west corner, x east, y south. Cell (row r, col c) covers x0M + c*cellM .. +cellM, y0M + r*cellM .. +cellM.
notes: HiRISE DTMs with 1 m posts resolve features a few metres across (Kirk et al. 2008, JGR 113, E00A24), so 2 m keeps the useful detail.
Covers the cabin, the descent stage, the parachute and backshell, the landing site and Ingenuity's airfield (south-east part).
